recentItems.title: i98fm | 3.35pm Aircheck (incl. "High School Hits" Segment) - (11.09.2026)
recentItems.description:
#i98fm #radioshow #wollongong 

Earlier this week, i98fm introduced a new segment during the drive show called “High School Hits”, where they pick a random year and play three chart hits from that year in consecutive order. Bizarrely, the segment only goes for about ten minutes before the 4pm newshour, and it isn’t even promoted beforehand!

They used to actually do something similar about 5+ years ago, however the hits weren’t all from the one year and the segment used to be on at 9am. I will be really interested to see just how far back they decide to go. They have a track record of randomly playing chart hits from the late '70s and early '80s (they haven’t done it for a little while though), so I could actually see them having one based on an '80s year at some point (which is amazing for a station with a contemporary Top-40 hits format)

Recorded off i98fm (via the website) on the 11th September 2026 at 3.35pm AEST.

recentItems.title: WIN News Illawarra | Full Bulletin - (07.08.2025)
recentItems.description:
#throwbackthursday 

It's amazing what can change in as little as 12 months! WIN News received a new on-air look tonight, so for comparison's sake, here's a flashback to how the Illawarra bulletin went to air on the 7th August 2025! 😁

Despite the fact that only a year has passed (well, almost!), there have actually been several changes to the WIN News team since that time. Sarah Cawte (pictured bottom-right) resigned from her position as weather presenter back in December and was replaced by Bo Jeong, Jack Mahony (bottom-left) joined NBN News in January and Ella Smith (top-right) became a Nine News reporter just last month!

This was also a couple of weeks before Lauren Ivory joined the WIN News team, if i'm not mistaken.

Recorded off 9HD Illawarra on the 7th August 2025.
